channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Three students die of snakebite at Maharashtra school
item.description: The incident took place in the early hours of Monday when the snake, a krait, is suspected to have entered the hostel of the Japatlai Residential Ashram School in Dhanora taluka, Gadchiroli

item.title: Supriya Sule’s meeting with PM sets off speculation over NCP(SP)’s stance on delimitation Bill
item.description: The party’s position on delimitation would be decided only after the government introduced a Bill in Parliament, NCP(SP) spokesperson Mahesh Tapase says in Mumbai

item.title: Lok Sabha passes Tribunals Reforms Bill amid din
item.description: Bill to set up a panel to oversee appointments to various national tribunals was cleared without a debate; Law Minister says it will bring uniformity to selection process and improve transparency

item.title: BJP asks Congress to withdraw support to hemant Soren govt; Rahul Gandhi slams police action
item.description: Jharkhand BJP leaders stage protest outside Chief Minister Hemant Soren’s residence, say lathi charge on students is the “final nail in the coffin” of the JMM-Congress government in the State

item.title: Protesters march to Jharkhand Assembly; 5 injured in clashes
item.description: Students, aspirants continue sit-in in Ranchi seeking cancellation of JSSC-CGL exam and CBI probe into irregularities; police deny use of force; former JPSC Chairman arrested; march comes day after State government agreed to cancel three exams

item.title: Protectors turn predators: how son preference fuels female foeticide rackets in Maharashtra
item.description: The arrest of a retired government doctor by the Kolhapur police on July 31 for allegedly orchestrating a sophisticated female foeticide ring shows that illegal abortion networks continue to operate in secret across the State

item.title: SP fears BSP the most, says Akash Anand, asks voters to be wary
Punjab passes nine Bills in a day; Oppn. calls it a ‘display of majoritarian arrogance’
Suvendu admits police negligence in custodial death of TMC worker
item.description: Day after Mamata Banerjee’s vehicle was attacked, CM visits family of Birju Keot; he orders probe by a magistrate, offers ₹10 lakh compensation to victim’s wife; IO suspended, station in-charge transferred

item.title: Haryana power employees defer strike by two months after government assurances
Cauvery Committee, Authority to meet on Tuesday to review water situation
item.description: As on date, the combined storage of four reservoirs in Karnataka was around 88 tmc ft. against the total capacity of 114.57 tmc ft.

item.title: T.N. Committee constituted to shortlist candidates for posts of non-hereditary trustees in temples
Nithin Raj case: Inquiry initiated against officer over alleged lapses in arrest procedure
item.description: State tells High Court it opted for oral inquiry to avoid a possible challenge to disciplinary action

item.title: 90-year-old Co-optex gets a Gen Z makeover
Secure release of boats from A.P., say fishermen
Six new judges assume office at Karnataka High Court
Microfinance scam in Kerala: SIT files final reports in 17 cases
item.description: Of the 124 cases probed, no irregularities were found in 30 cases, S. Sasidharan, head of the SIT, informed the Kerala High Court on Monday.

item.title: Row in Kerala over pension delivery
item.description: Government needs to find a balance between various modes of welfare transfers

item.title: If harmful chemicals are found in cosmetics, we will ban them: U.T. Khader
item.description: A total of 22 cosmetic samples were collected by Drugs Inspectors and Assistant Drugs Inspectors from various places on Monday.

item.title: 3(a) notification issued for Kochi Outer Ring Road
item.description: The 3A notification issued in 2024 for what was then the 44-km-long, six-lane NH linking Angamaly and Netoor had expired that year, reportedly for want of follow-up action

item.title: Woman councillor allegedly stabbed by father-in-law in Kerala’s Piravom
item.description: According to the FIR, the woman was attacked by her father-in-law as she used to question him for physically assaulting his wife

item.title: Six key GST officials in Chennai transferred
Government to preserve tribal heritage while promoting education and jobs, says official
T.N. government’s proposed four-year undergraduate programme faces resistance from students, faculty
item.description: Many allege that the move smacks of duality in the government’s stand on National Education Policy (NEP) 2020

item.title: Two families adopt animals under IGZP’s Animal Adoption Programme
Jharkhand students protest updates: Mahto hospitalised as health deteriorates; police lathi-charge protesters again outside Assembly
item.description: Jharkhand BJP announces a State-wide bandh on August 10 to protest against police crackdown on student protesters

item.title: Polavaram celebrates the first International Day of the World’s Indigenous Peoples
Distribution of deworming tablets begins in Cuddalore
Cane crushing begins at co-operative sugar mill in Kallakurichi
Tamil Nadu Assured Pension Scheme will be implemented as soon as Centre sanctions borrowing of ₹11,000 crore, says Marie Wilson
item.description: Until then, we have decided to give an interim payout to those who retired or are retiring on or after January 1, 2026. We will implement the scheme as soon as the Union government accords sanction, says the Finance Minister

item.title: Kerala will push organic farming in a big way: Agriculture Minister
item.description: As excessive pesticide residues were found in 58 out of the 1,262 food items which were tested in the government labs across the State

item.title: KLU organises ‘AI BUILD 2026’ hackathon
Karnataka takes cautious first step to introduce digital evaluation of SSLC and II PU examination
item.description: Following the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) footsteps, the Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board is planning to implement digital evaluation of SSLC and II PU answer scripts. However, it is being cautious in the rollout

item.title: Swell waves likely along coast of Thiruvananthapuram on Tuesday
item.description: Issuing alerts to fishermen and coastal residents, the National Centre for Oceanographic Studies and Research (INCOIS) has informed that, as part of the swell surge, waves ranging in height from 1.0 to 1.6 meters and sea erosion are likely along the coasts from Kappil to Pozhiyur in Thiruvananthapuram district till 11.30 pm on Tuesday

item.title: Talks planned to resolve Piramadam church ownership dispute
item.description: Talks follow Sunday clash between Jacobite, Orthodox factions

item.title: Sai Krishna case: Court summons Tirupati MP to record statement
Collector opens second phase of Dream anti-drug initiative
item.description: Led by the Don Bosco Veedu Society and BREADS, Dream II will be implemented in 10 districts of the State till 2029

item.title: Navy chief begins four-day Mauritius visit to boost maritime ties
item.description: The engagements reflect the shared vision of MAHASAGAR — Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions – and India’s emphasis on strengthening maritime security and cooperation across the Indian Ocean

item.title: Pre-marital counselling launched at 178 Santwana Kendras in Karnataka
Telangana government extends deadline to apply for affordable flats in Hyderabad (CURE) till August 15
Kochi Corporation puts brakes on arbitrary renaming of roads
item.description: Existing road names not to be changed at whim of individuals, organisations; new names to be assigned only to roads without existing names; move follows past renaming attempts that led to protests and litigation

item.title: Gandhi temple getting ready for I-day celebrations
item.description: The Gandhi Mandiram-Freedom Fighters Smruthi Vanam came up on 50 cents of an old park allotted by the Municipal Corporation on January 30, 2022; hundreds of students will take part in the Independence Day programme

item.title: Jharkhand student protest: Jharkhand BJP calls for bandh tomorrow over police crackdown against protesting aspirants
item.description: Chief Minister Hemant Soren appealed to the students not to fall into the trap of any political narrative, asserting that students are the future of Jharkhand.

item.title: Activists question Tamil Nadu Speaker J.C.D. Prabhakar’s participation in ‘pro-life’ rally
item.description: They contend that a constitutional office-holder taking part in such an event could set a wrong precedent on women’s reproductive autonomy

item.title: Kerala University removes banners and boards from campuses
item.description: Vice-Chancellor in-charge Mohanan Kunnummal had directed the organisations to remove the banners and boards within 24 hours a day ago

item.title: Bangladesh urges India to expedite Sheikh Hasina’s extradition
item.description: Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi calls on Prime Minister Tarique Rahman; “somewhat reassured” after meeting, says Bangladesh; exchanged views on “matters of mutual interest”, says India

item.title: K.M. Basheer hit-and-run case: witnesses give crucial testimony in court
item.description: Two friends of the accused, IAS officer Sriram Venkitaraman, Anish Raj and Athul Vijayakumar, were examined as the 10th and 11th witnesses at the Thiruvananthapuram Additional District and Sessions Court IV

item.title: BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi, Congress of changing goalposts, disrupting House
item.description: The government has never shied away from taking up any issue, senior leader J.P. Nadda says; challenges the Leader of the Opposition to debate any issue in the Lok Sabha

item.title: 11 new entry points added for foreigners to enter India: Home Ministry
item.description: The Ministry says the newly notified entry points comprise airports at Bhopal and Tirupati, and land ports of Agartala, Darranga, Gede, Ghojadanga, Haridaspur, Jaigaon, Dawki, Moreh and Attari (Road)

item.title: Former Minister M.R.K. Panneerselvam sparks lively exchanges in Tamil Nadu Assembly
item.description: He says that in the past, he would relax only after 8 a.m. because his leader, Kalaignar [M. Karunanidhi], would call him up early in the morning. “You [the Ministers] seem very relaxed,” he says. Minister for Water Resources N. Anand responds that Mr. Vijay will call him up and other Ministers even about repairing a vaikal (canal) and ask whether the work has been completed

item.title: Allahabad HC upholds religious conversion of two women, orders UP govt. and father to pay ₹25 lakh compensation
item.description: Hearing a habeas corpus petition, the court holds that the siblings aged 35 and 20 years were entitled to decide their faith, residence and personal affairs as adults

item.title: Over a fifth of the electors in Telangana might get deleted in SIR
Not turbulence: Air India A320 suffered rare flight-control event before 300-foot altitude drop
item.description: Nine technical snags in a minute, including an autopilot disconnect, hydraulic failures and faults affecting the systems that control the aircraft’s nose-up and nose-down movement; Air India writes to Airbus

item.title: Protesting Maharashtra farmers demand ₹2 lakh incentive for regular loan repayment
item.description: Along with a waiver of up to ₹2 lakh, farmers, who paid EMI’s regularly were supposed to receive incentive of ₹50,000, which farmers believe is unfair

item.title: Ernakulam General Hospital plans mobile human milk collection unit
item.description: Unit to collect breast milk from donor lactating mothers outside the hospital; move aimed at strengthening human milk bank and bringing more mothers into donor network

item.title: Civil police officers to assist consumer dispute redressal commissions across Kerala
item.description: Civil police officers serving with magistrate, sessions courts to be deployed; Personnel to assist in executing summons, warrants and orders; move follows High Court concern over lack of police assistance for Commissions

item.title: UPI will remain free for consumers, Nirmala Sitharaman tells Rajya Sabha
item.description: Amid the Opposition walkout, Rajya Sabha passes the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill and returns the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill

item.title: Bharath offers ₹20 lakh aid to family of deceased medical student
item.description: Minister travels to Eklaspur village in Jogulamba Gadwal district of Telangana and pays floral tributes to Priyanka’s mortal remains

item.title: Land re-survey exercise will be completed by end of 2027, says A.P. CM
item.description: Strong security features, similar to those used for currency notes, have been incorporated into pattadar passbooks, says Naidu, addding that blockchain technology is being used to check tampering with land details

item.title: India donates five peacocks to UN office in Geneva
item.description: The five young peacocks comprise four blue peafowl and one white-feathered male, reflecting the blue and white colours associated with the United Nations
